targetTexts.1: When you sit down to dine with a ruler, consider carefully what is set before you,
targetTexts.2: and put a knife to your throat if you possess a great appetite.
targetTexts.3: Do not crave his delicacies, for that food is deceptive.
targetTexts.4: Do not wear yourself out to get rich; be wise enough to restrain yourself.
targetTexts.5: When you glance at wealth, it disappears, for it makes wings for itself and flies like an eagle to the sky.
targetTexts.6: Do not eat the bread of a stingy man, and do not crave his delicacies;
targetTexts.7: for he is keeping track, inwardly counting the cost. “Eat and drink,” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
targetTexts.8: You will vomit up what little you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.
targetTexts.9: Do not speak to a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
targetTexts.10: Do not move an ancient boundary stone or encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
targetTexts.11: for their Redeemer is strong; He will take up their case against you.
targetTexts.12: Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to words of knowledge.
targetTexts.13: Do not withhold discipline from a child; although you strike him with a rod, he will not die.
targetTexts.14: Strike him with a rod, and you will deliver his soul from Sheol.
targetTexts.15: My son, if your heart is wise, my own heart will indeed rejoice.
targetTexts.16: My inmost being will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
targetTexts.17: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always continue in the fear of the LORD.
targetTexts.18: For surely there is a future, and your hope will not be cut off.
targetTexts.19: Listen, my son, and be wise, and guide your heart on the right course.
targetTexts.20: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat.
targetTexts.21: For the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty, and drowsiness will clothe them in rags.
targetTexts.22: Listen to your father who gave you life, and do not despise your mother when she is old.
targetTexts.23: Invest in truth and never sell it—in wisdom and instruction and understanding.
targetTexts.24: The father of a righteous man will greatly rejoice, and he who fathers a wise son will delight in him.
targetTexts.25: May your father and mother be glad, and may she who gave you birth rejoice!
targetTexts.26: My son, give me your heart, and let your eyes delight in my ways.
targetTexts.27: For a prostitute is a deep pit, and an adulteress is a narrow well.
targetTexts.28: Like a robber she lies in wait and multiplies the faithless among men.
targetTexts.29: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has contentions? Who has complaints? Who has needless wounds? Who has bloodshot eyes?
targetTexts.30: Those who linger over wine, who go to taste mixed drinks.
targetTexts.31: Do not gaze at wine while it is red, when it sparkles in the cup and goes down smoothly.
targetTexts.32: In the end it bites like a snake and stings like a viper.
targetTexts.33: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will utter perversities.
targetTexts.34: You will be like one sleeping on the high seas or lying on the top of a mast:
targetTexts.35: “They struck me, but I feel no pain! They beat me, but I did not know it! When can I wake up to search for another drink?”
